title: Ares witness adapter (client of rso.binding): arms, observer, receipts, binding rows -- plumbing only
objective: Build rso/witness/ares_client.py: the seven arm wrappers of DESIGN_DRAFT s4 (S, S-NOPL, S-LEAK, POS, RECUR, NULL, SHUF) without editing ares/, an episode runner over registered seeds with rollout(record=True) as the observer, canonical receipt bytes per predicate node (subject = genome bytes digest, world variant + code refs, seeds, observer id, action traces and oracle values as artifacts) and one ledger row per node execution (parent_run_id, receipt_sha256 via rso.binding), so that binding.binding_reasons() binds every produced receipt.
parent_objective: native witness preparation (opens as its own campaign only if C-009 closes)
problem: Plumbing tests only, on random or hand-wired organisms: determinism under fixed seeds; each wrapper demonstrably applied (e.g. S-LEAK leaves live W1 unrestored, S-NOPL has no plastic update, SHUF decouples cue from r) checked on internal state, not on accuracy; record=True vs record=False give identical actions (P-OBS plumbing); every produced receipt binds (binding_reasons == []) and a tampered receipt does not. Predicate functions (P-CAL, P-RET, P-CHAN, P-ERASE, P-PRES) may be written as code with unit tests on SYNTHETIC action arrays, but must not be evaluated on any Ares arm output. Opaque node ids (BX6).
non_goals: No subject evolution; no witness predicate; no retention or accuracy statistic for any arm or control (SELECTION.md gate)
No edit of ares/ sources (adapter-side wrappers only)
No change to rso/binding or the slice evidence plane (BX6)
evidence_required: RED: binding test of a produced receipt fails before the adapter exists
a statement that no accuracy/retention number was computed on any arm

acceptance.condition: all evidence_required items; no outcome observed
